text: How to Transfer Crypto between Binance and Wazirx App to start your crypto trading journey on Binance, you need to have crypto available on your Binance account. You can use Wazirx app to move your funds between Wazirx account and Binance Wallet at zero cost in India. Let's take a look step by step. Connect your Binance and Wazirx accounts before getting started. Open or create your Binance account and make sure to complete the identity verification and two factor authentication, also known as 2FA. Then you can follow these steps. Log into your Binance app, select Wallets, click on Add Account, choose Wazirx, then click on Activate Connect Wazirx. Click Login via Binance and a window for the Binance login will pop up. Please make sure that your Binance and Wazirx accounts have the same email address, then click Continue. Authenticate your account with two FA process. You've now successfully integrated your Binance and WazirX accounts. STEP 2 Buy cryptocurrency on WazirX Log into the WazirX using your Binance account. Click on Exchange. Select the crypto you want to buy. Let's try to buy btc. Insert the amount of Indian rupees that you want to spend, then click on Buy btc. Transfer Cryptocurrency from Wazirx to Binance Once you have bought btc, go to Funds and select Transfer Funds to Binance. Select the cryptocurrency and enter the amount that you want to transfer. Click on Transfer to Binance. Complete the transfer by using your WazirX2FA. You will receive your cryptocurrency in your Binance wallet. You can now enjoy the flexibility of the Wazirx account and start exploring various Binance products.
